feed.title: Track Awesome List Updates Weekly
feed.subtitle: We track over 500 awesome list updates, and you can also subscribe to daily or weekly updates via RSS or News Letter.

entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Oct 26 - Nov 01, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Bigdata

Data Ingestion

  • OLake (⭐1.5k) - Open-source replication of Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Kafka and S3 into Apache Iceberg, with CDC and table maintenance. Written in Go.
  • Datanika - open-source ELT platform pairing dlt extract-and-load with dbt-core transformations, plus scheduling and run history in one self-hosted UI.

Distributed Tracing Platform

  • Jaeger - Jaeger: open source, distributed tracing platform for monitor and troubleshoot workflows in complex distributed systems

Columnar Databases

  • KoldStore (⭐6) - experimental PostgreSQL tiered-storage extension that moves historical rows to Parquet and queries supported hot and cold data through the original table; not production-ready.

Data Quality and Observability

  • DataOps TestGen (⭐80) - open-source data quality tool that profiles tables, generates tests from the profiling results, and monitors freshness, volume, and schema, with a web UI.

Benchmarking

  • HiBench Next (⭐1) - Modernized HiBench suite for reproducible Apache Spark benchmarking, featuring 24 Scala/PySpark workloads, Web UI, REST API, and CLI.
  • DeathStarBench (⭐957) - Open-source benchmark suite for cloud microservices.
  • CloudSuite (⭐239) - A Benchmark Suite for Cloud Services.
  • YCSB (⭐5.2k) - Yahoo! Cloud Serving Benchmark
  • TailBench - TailBench: A Benchmark Suite and Evaluation Methodology for Latency-Critical Applications
  • SProBench (⭐2) - SProBench: Stream Processing Benchmark for High Performance Computing

Applications

  • TradeData - API for customs, shipment and international trade data, supporting supply-chain and market analysis.

Search engine and framework

  • Manticore Search (⭐12k) - open-source search database for full-text, vector, and hybrid search with real-time indexing and SQL.

Business Intelligence

  • Beekeeper Studio - cross-platform SQL client for querying and exploring analytical databases and warehouses like ClickHouse, BigQuery, Redshift, and DuckDB.
  • DAC (⭐795) - dashboard-as-code tool defining dashboards in YAML and TSX, with a built-in semantic layer.

Data Visualization

  • FlexViz (⭐73) - open-source Python library for interactive cross-filter dashboards on large datasets, answering each zoom and selection with a lazy Polars aggregation instead of sending rows to the browser.

2. Awesome Webgl

Maps and Visualizations / Particles

  • TradeCanvas (⭐28) - Financial charting library that draws candles, indicators and depth heatmaps with WebGL 2, falling back to Canvas 2D.
  • Globedots (⭐2) - Dot-matrix globe on WebGL2 in 17 kB, with markers, arcs, labels, heat maps, and a day-night line.
  • leaflet-webgl-markers (⭐2) - Leaflet plugin for rendering millions of point markers on a single WebGL canvas, with FBO picking and zero redraw while dragging.
  • WorldSeed (⭐1) - Turns open geospatial data into playable, exportable Three.js worlds with terrain-aware roads, GLB, road graphs, spawn points, and versioned JSON Schema.

Articles

  • Houdini to Three.js: Testing glTF Compression and Instancing - Case study of geometry, texture compression and instancing with WebGPU and WebGL2 checks.

Tools/Debugging

  • Fast3D - Browser-based 3D toolbox: convert between GLB, GLTF, OBJ, STL, FBX and PLY, compress models and preview them in a full-featured viewer. Everything runs client-side.
  • Web3D Viewer (⭐2) - Single-file OBJ viewer that logs how every MTL texture reference was resolved (exact path, extension-stripped, fuzzy) and which ones failed, so missing materials are traceable instead of silently rendering black.

Tutorials / Firefox Specific Tools/Debugger

  • TutorialSearch - Free cross-platform search engine indexing 50,000+ tutorials from Udemy, Skillshare, Pluralsight, and other major learning platforms across 45+ categories.
  • A tutorial on infinite canvas with WebGL - A hands-on tutorial for building a GPU-accelerated infinite canvas in the browser, with first-class WebGL support (and WebGPU) via a unified graphics API—covering ECS, SDF-based 2D primitives, GPU text, and tile-based rendering, by @xiaoiver.

Articles / Firefox Specific Tools/Debugger

  • Zero Bytes of Geometry: A Metal Lattice Sphere-Traced in a 14.9 KB Page - Ray marching a signed distance field in raw WebGL 2, with an analytic environment in place of an HDR file and resolution adapted against the display refresh period.

Compute (GPGPU) / Computer Vision

  • Speedy Vision (⭐193) - GPU-accelerated Computer Vision library for JavaScript.

Compute (GPGPU) / Particles

  • NixieFX (⭐19) - Particle and VFX runtime for PixiJS and Three.js, authored in a browser-based editor.

WebAR / Particles

  • encantar.js (⭐125) - GPU-accelerated Augmented Reality library that works on any device (iOS, Android, desktops). Easy to use and requires no WebXR support.

WebGL 2 / Particles

  • dither-flow (⭐1) - Cursor-stirred 1-bit dithered flow field, WebGL 2 only, zero dependencies.
  • textmode.js (⭐174) - Lightweight, framework-agnostic creative coding library for real-time ASCII and textmode graphics using WebGL2.
  • Vysmo Transitions (⭐9) - Tree-shakable WebGL 2 library of 60 endpoint-correct transitions with mesh and multi-pass support, ~5 KB gzipped.

Others / Particles

  • img2threejs (⭐19k) - Toolkit that rebuilds the object in a reference image as a code-only, procedural Three.js model - primitives, procedural shaders, generated geometry, no downloaded meshes.
  • zephyr3d - A TypeScript-based 3D rendering engine with WebGPU/WebGL support.

3. Awesome Testing

Software / Service Virtualization

  • fieldtwin - Open-source, local, stateful twins of the Jobber and QuickBooks Online APIs for integration and AI agent tests, with checkpoints, rewind, and faults on demand.
  • MockForge (⭐12) - Open-source API mock server written in Rust for HTTP/OpenAPI, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket, Kafka, MQTT and AMQP, with data generation and latency/fault injection.
  • OutageFence (⭐0) - Local HTTP fault-injection CLI by Slanta Cause that checks synthetic sensitive data against declared destination rules, with positive controls and offline reports.

Software / API Testing

  • SolidPing (⭐17) - Open-source (AGPL-3.0) uptime and API monitoring with a free hosted tier. Runs HTTP, gRPC, WebSocket and custom JS checks on a schedule and alerts when an endpoint fails.
  • API Spector - Open-source API clien, mock server and contract testing tool. Zero telemetry.
  • Openhook (⭐1) - Open-source webhook inbox for capturing callbacks and inspecting request headers and bodies through a browser, REST API, or MCP.
  • BestJSON JSON Diff - Free browser tool for comparing saved JSON API responses by structure, with explicit array-order and record-ID matching rules.

Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

  • Device Hub Pro (⭐136) - Free, open-source macOS app for manual testing on Android emulators, Android phones and iOS simulators side by side, with live mirroring, device controls (network, location, permissions, deep links, push), logs, screenshots and screen recordings.
  • App Crash Lab (⭐3) - MIT-licensed Node 22+/Playwright CLI that checks saved web-app values after reload and rejected updates, exporting state diffs and standalone Playwright tests.
  • Browser Use (⭐118k) - Open-source (MIT) Python AI agent that runs plain-English tasks in a real browser. Browser Use Cloud adds hosted stealth Chromium you can drive over CDP from Playwright, Puppeteer or Selenium, with session recordings and live view.
  • ContextQA MCP - Hosted MCP server for creating and running end-to-end tests and investigating failures, with OAuth browser sign-in.
  • Proxy QA Browser (⭐1) - Free, open-source desktop app to test your own web forms by US location, emulated device and browser, with recorded scenarios, consent and accessibility checks, and a CI runner.
  • vibe-testing (⭐17) - Open-source MCP server and CLI that scans web app routes and forms, runs browser checks with Playwright, and produces HTML QA reports.
  • Device Changer - Applies device models, build fingerprints and identifiers to rooted Android test devices to reproduce device-specific bugs.

Software / Accessibility & Usability Testing

  • Oh My Android (⭐60) - Free, open-source macOS app for checking Android apps on emulators and phones in dark mode, large font sizes, RTL and TalkBack, with a TalkBack-order accessibility audit.
  • AuditReady - Runs 12 deterministic HTML checks on a page against WCAG 2.2 and returns the matching criterion and a suggested fix for each finding, then turns them into a printable report an agency can hand to its client. Free instant scan; the full report is a one-off $29.
  • Site Spell Checker - Crawls a live website and flags spelling and grammar mistakes on every page, each shown in context with its page URL. Free one-page scan; the full-site scan is a one-off $99.

Software / AI & LLM Testing

  • fanout-check (⭐1) - Offline Python library and CLI that checks observed concurrency, overlap, and launch timing in explicitly grouped tool or agent calls.

Software / Visual Testing

  • CurlShot - Screenshot API for capturing baseline and comparison images of web pages in CI as PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF, with full-page and CSS-selector element capture, device presets and ad/cookie-banner blocking. Free plan available.
  • cloneproof (⭐0) - Scores how closely a website clone matches the original (pixels, layout, style, scroll motion) with Playwright and lists the exact differences.

Software / Test Report Diagnostics

  • junit-collision-check (⭐0) - Offline Python CLI that detects duplicate test identities and conflicting outcomes across JUnit XML reports before CI report ingestion.

Software / Test Data Management

  • TempMail Hub - Free disposable inbox for manual or scripted signup and email-verification testing, with a selectable lifetime from 10 minutes to 7 days and no account required.
  • Mails.ai - Email inboxes for automated tests: a plus address per test and one call that waits for the email and returns the sign-up code or magic link, with TypeScript and Python SDKs, Cypress and Playwright packages and an MCP server.
  • ByteRivet Sample Files - Free browser-based generator for exact-size dummy files from 1 KB to 2 GB in 22 formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, JSON, ZIP, MP4, WAV and more) for upload-limit and file-handling tests. Files are built locally, no upload or signup.
  • FormFiller test data tools - Free browser-based generators for fake addresses, identities, IBANs, test card numbers and bulk CSV/JSON/SQL data in 22 locales.

Software / Browser Extensions & Utilities

  • Keploy API Test Recorder - Chrome extension that records API calls from your browser session and turns them into API tests.
  • Spoof Me - Test how a site behaves for users in other browsers, OSes, languages, timezones and screen sizes by switching the whole browser identity. Also available for Firefox.

Software / Performance & Load Testing

  • check-proxy-tax (⭐0) - Zero-dependency CLI that samples a URL concurrently, then reports the 403 retry tax: usable-response rate and effective cost per 1,000 usable responses instead of the nominal per-1,000 price.

Software / Test Automation Frameworks

  • behave (⭐2) - Records how a command-line tool behaves (flags, stdin, exit codes, edge cases) as golden tests and replays them against another implementation, e.g. a Rust or Go rewrite.
  • VeriSpec (⭐0) - Spec-driven quality engineering framework that turns specifications into traceable test strategies, native test suites, and continuous release evidence.

Software / Static Analysis

  • SmartBench (⭐2) - Open-source CLI for evidence-constrained code audits: deterministic static analysis owns the facts and LLM hypotheses must be validated against the code before they become findings.

Newsletters / Static Analysis

  • RoleGig QA & Testing - Weekly list of QA, test automation and SDET jobs in India, the US, Canada, Europe, Australia and the Gulf.

4. Awesome Mysql

Binlog-Replication

  • dbtrail (⭐64) - Analytical replica of MySQL: keeps tables as Parquet files fed from the binlog, queried with DuckDB

5. Awesome Quant

Market Data & Data Sources

  • alphai-tui (⭐77) - Rust TUI - Terminal stock dashboard with keyless quotes, candlestick charts and portfolio tracking, plus optional news and SEC filing views powered by the AlphAI API.
  • prop-firm-rules (⭐1) - Python JavaScript Data - Sourced, dated dataset of prop-trading-firm daily-loss and max-drawdown rules (static and trailing, lock levels, reset times) for 9 firms and 13 programs, with a zero-dependency JS/Python drawdown calculator.
  • canli-pit-lake (⭐0) - Python DuckDB Parquet - Point-in-time market-data lake where every read takes an explicit as-of, corporate actions filter on when they became knowable, and delisted names are kept.
  • Gloomberb (⭐2.5k) - TypeScript Bun - Open-source finance terminal for quotes, charts, news, filings and portfolios, as a terminal UI, desktop app and web app.
  • Fonrex - Python Docker REST - Self-hosted financial data API for European and US markets: prices per listing, cross-checked fundamentals from 18 sources, DCF valuation and Fama/French factors in your own PostgreSQL. GitHub (⭐1)
  • Seiche (⭐1) - Python REST MCP - Money-market and dollar-funding research with public-source collectors, historical observations, separate release and retrieval clocks, and explicit coverage gaps.
  • CNEquity (⭐730) - Python MCP A-shares - Self-hosted China A-share data lake that keeps 55 datasets (prices, financials, capital flows, corporate events, futures and options) in local Parquet with incremental updates, point-in-time queries, delisted-stock retention, DuckDB SQL and a read-only MCP server.
  • yfinance-ir (⭐2) - Python - yfinance-shaped market data for Iranian markets: TSETMC equities, ETFs, indices and option chains, Codal financial statements, TGJU FX and gold, SCI CPI and Iranian crypto exchanges.
  • ws-wire-audit (⭐0) - Python - WebSocket wire-level measurement tool for exchange market-data feeds: frame and control-frame accounting, payload-vs-wire byte ratios, compression negotiation checks, and a documented API-contract audit.
  • edgar-full-text-search-examples (⭐0) - Python SEC EDGAR - Stdlib-only EDGAR full-text search to CSV that splits date ranges to get past the 10,000-result cap.
  • ninjatrader-to-parquet (⭐10) - Python - NinjaTrader 8 .ncd tick and minute history files to Parquet without NinjaTrader running; row-exact against NinjaTrader's own export, incremental re-runs.

Financial Instruments & Pricing

  • vanna (⭐2) - Python - Black-Scholes and CRR-binomial options pricing with Greek-attributed backtest P&L, decomposing each trade into delta, gamma, theta, vega, vanna, and volga via a second-order Taylor expansion.
  • stochPathSim (⭐15) - Python - Stochastic path simulation (Heston, rough Bergomi, Kou, curve-fitted Hull-White and G2++, CIR, commodity and credit models) with Monte Carlo pricing, exposure/CVA, risk-factor backtesting and a model-validation lab producing interactive Plotly HTML reports.
  • CustomDerivative - R - Black-Scholes-Merton pricing, Monte Carlo with antithetic and control variates and confidence intervals, path-dependent payoffs and finite-difference Greeks. GitHub (⭐2)
  • stochastic-rs - Rust Python - Quantitative finance library with 130+ stochastic processes, option pricing and calibration, volatility surfaces and copulas, SIMD/GPU accelerated with Python bindings. GitHub (⭐194)

Technical Indicators

  • Repaint Check (⭐0) - Pine - Records an EMA-cross signal during realtime bars and marks signals absent at the confirmed close.
  • yfinance-ta-patterns (⭐1) - Python - Candlestick and chart pattern recognition library for Yahoo Finance OHLCV market data.
  • technical-indicators (⭐0) - TypeScript - Dependency-free technical indicators (RSI, MACD, Bollinger, ATR, ADX, Ichimoku, SuperTrend…) with hand-verifiable tests, open datasets with provenance and reproducible behaviour reports.
  • gamma-seed (⭐2) - Python Pine Options - Daily dealer-gamma levels (gamma flip, call and put walls, max pain, expected move) for DAX, Nasdaq, Dow and gold, computed from options open interest (Eurex ODAX for the DAX, ETF proxies for the US) and written into a TradingView Pine v6 indicator; the method is documented in open studies on the author's site. Website

Trading & Backtesting

  • QuantDinger (⭐13k) - Python - Self-hosted platform for AI-assisted Python strategy development, backtesting, and paper and live trading across crypto exchanges and traditional brokers.
  • ALPHAC (⭐1) - Python - Cross-asset research and paper-trading engine with point-in-time data, walk-forward validation, multiple-testing accounting and a published forward record.
  • trading-research-agents (⭐36) - Python MCP - Autonomous trading system for crypto linear perpetuals in which language models only propose and deterministic rules decide: code computes every figure, prices the full round trip before an order exists, sizes from the operator's risk at the stop, keeps exits at the exchange, and records each cycle with a per-file SHA-256 that can be re-verified.
  • Desic Terminal (⭐33) - Rust TypeScript - MIT-licensed desktop terminal for OKX USDT perpetuals that pairs live discretionary trading with systematic research: realtime WebSocket market data, 24 indicators, a market-wide radar, AI assistants with typed wake conditions, and a bundled Python runtime for 1-minute backtests. Permission modes (advisor / copilot / limited_auto) are enforced by the runtime rather than by the prompt, and demo and live credentials are isolated.
  • Evidence Deflator (⭐0) - Python MCP - Checks how much of an LLM trading backtest falls on or before the model's training cutoff and how many clean months a claimed Sharpe needs once the number of attempts is counted, with an MCP server and an evidence-adjusted leaderboard of public AI trading competitions.
  • OpenBacktesting (⭐6) - Python - Historical single-asset backtesting with pandas-based statistics, technical indicators, and grid or SAMBO parameter optimization.
  • AlphaFinch (⭐2) - Python LLM - AlphaEvolve-style search in which an LLM invents and evolves trading strategies as Python code, judged on sealed holdouts and a pre-registered multi-market exam whose bar corrects for every attempt.
  • canli-backtest (⭐0) - Python - Backtester that raises on look-ahead (decide at close, fill at next open), replays funding and corporate actions point-in-time, and reports deflated Sharpe against the full trial count.
  • tilt-check (⭐0) - Python TabPFN Gemma - Pre-trade check and written audit from your own NinjaTrader trade history: sessions in market time, first trades of the day, re-entries after a loss, exit replay on minute bars, and written rules checked against the chart without look-ahead; never places orders.
  • Optra (⭐24) - C++ Python - Options trading system: one event-driven engine for backtesting and live trading on Interactive Brokers, with pricing, volatility and risk research tools.
  • Sharpen (⭐8) - Python - Open-source agentic-AI quant strategy builder that tries to disprove a strategy before it ships, including Crucible, an alpha-miner (Apache-2.0).
  • backtest-audit-kit (⭐0) - Python - Dependency-free audit toolkit for backtests (no numpy/pandas): detects look-ahead, checks cash/position ledger conservation, flags fee and funding double-counting, and mutation-tests your own suite for blind spots.
  • Lumina Capital (⭐4) - Python - Autonomous multi-agent quantitative hedge fund engine powered by LangGraph, Qlib Alpha158, and Google TimesFM.
  • TokIO (⭐4) - Python Pine Script - Backtest significance checker with published false-positive rates: dependence-robust tests corrected for every variant tried (Romano-Wolf), deflated and probabilistic Sharpe ratios, probability of backtest overfitting, breakeven costs and a one-bar lookahead check, taking vectorbt portfolios, backtesting.py results and TradingView trade exports directly.
  • perpbrain-sdk - TypeScript MCP - Hyperliquid perpetuals order-book fill simulator with fee, slippage and owner-limit checks, an execution-cost breakdown, and receipt verification that re-derives result hashes from the inputs.
  • LR-AutoInvest (⭐0) - Python CLI - Offline daily-bar paper accounts with idempotent CSV updates, price-history revision checks, configurable trading costs, and explainable rebalance plans.
  • matching-engine - Rust - Single-node spot order matching with price-time priority, fixed-point prices and quantities, and optional write-ahead-log recovery. GitHub (⭐1)
  • tradefloor (⭐0) - Python Rust - Generates simulated stock markets for testing trading strategies and AI agents, with a limit order book per company and an economy underneath, so orders fill against the book and move prices, and any run can be forked or replayed exactly.
  • tradingview-mcp (⭐5.1k) - Python MCP - MCP server that gives AI assistants screeners, multi-timeframe technical analysis and walk-forward backtests for stocks, crypto, forex and futures across global exchanges.
  • IBKR-Telegram (⭐2) - Python Telegram - Self-hosted Telegram bot for Interactive Brokers that runs next to IB Gateway: position snapshots and P&L tracking, plus option orders from chat commands or webhook signals, each confirmed in Telegram before it is sent, with market-hours, duplicate-signal and position-limit checks on webhook signals.
  • nt8-mcp (⭐24) - C# Python MCP - MCP server and NinjaTrader 8 AddOn that give an AI coding assistant a build loop for NinjaScript: offline and in-platform compile with structured errors, chart and log reads, headless backtests, optimization and walk-forward; read-only by default.

Portfolio Optimization & Risk Analysis

  • portfolio-risk-lab (⭐3) - Python - Uncertainty-aware portfolio optimization: compare covariance estimates, test allocations across risk scenarios, and see the cost of tighter constraints.
  • dca-ladder-calculator (⭐0) - JavaScript Crypto - Zero-dependency calculator for DCA order ladders on crypto perpetual futures that gives the average entry, take-profit, break-even and liquidation price (isolated or cross margin) after every order.
  • Deadlatch (⭐0) - Python MCP - Local, advisory-only pre-trade risk gate for trading agents with 12 deterministic fail-closed rules and a local audit log.
  • stochastly-calculators (⭐0) - TypeScript - Tested implementations of the probabilistic and deflated Sharpe ratios, minimum track record length, probability of backtest overfitting (CSCV) and a seeded prop-firm challenge simulator, each folder giving the formula and its source paper.
  • position-sizing-data (⭐1) - Data - Reference data and worked arithmetic for position sizing across forex, stocks and crypto futures: contract specifications (pip size, contract size, minimum step) for 131 instruments, pip value and 20-pip loss by lot size, losing-streak equity decay and drawdown-recovery tables, plus the risk-to-units formulas with two worked examples.

Time Series Analysis

  • NoiseFloor (⭐0) - Python MCP - Offline financial time-series diagnostics, correlation spectra, change detection, and forecast evaluation with explicit coverage and input-data rights checks.

Prediction Markets

  • oracle3 (⭐476) - Python MCP - Trading engine and MCP server for prediction markets with fee-aware no-arbitrage checks across related event contracts, statistical arbitrage, and live or paper execution on Kalshi, Polymarket, and Solana.
  • OpenThomas (⭐24) - Python MCP - Autonomous weather-market trading agent for Kalshi and Polymarket that learns per-station forecast bias from leak-free hindcasts and sizes positions with fractional Kelly under hard risk limits.
  • pm-hftbacktest (⭐125) - Rust Python - High-frequency trading and market-making backtesting for Polymarket, written in Rust, with queue position, latency and maker/taker fee models applied to tick-level L2 order book and trade data.

Visualization

  • Flowdepth (⭐18) - Rust Desktop - Open-source crypto order-flow terminal with footprint charts, historical L2 liquidity heatmaps, volume bubbles, CVD, and BTC/ETH/SOL options GEX analytics.
  • Kandle - TypeScript MCP - Browser charting app for crypto, stocks and forex with indicators, a scripting language with strategy backtests, alerts, bar replay and an MCP server for AI agents. GitHub (⭐0)
  • OpenKline - TypeScript - Canvas-based OHLCV charting engine with technical indicators, drawing tools, and streaming-data support. GitHub (⭐1)

Quant Research Environments

  • AxonX (⭐5) - Python MCP - Agent-native quantitative research harness with plugin-based tasks for data processing, factor analysis, model training, and backtesting, traceable artifacts, and CLI and web interfaces.
  • thesis-ci (⭐1) - Python CLI YAML - Linter and CI for written investment theses that fails a number without a filing citation, freezes test thresholds once results are out, and Brier-scores forecasts.
  • easy-stock (⭐1.5k) - Go React A-shares - Local-first AI research workbench for China A-shares: unified market overview, theme radar, limit-up ladder and sentiment-cycle analysis, AI stock reports, portfolio inspection, and agent-based collection of post-market commentary with evidence tracing.
  • AlphaLattice (⭐1) - Python Claude Code Codex - Local research workbench that a coding agent drives from one sentence: dated US large-cap research positions bounded by each date's information cutoff, SEC-filing evidence review, and an investment committee that changes no numbers.
  • SmartMoney-Cub (⭐27) - Python LLM - Local-first, agent-agnostic trading journal and review harness that freezes point-in-time run envelopes and evidence packs, replays them deterministically, and evaluates rule candidates against a frozen 240-case finance benchmark, with no order or broker access.

Reproducing Works, Training & Books

  • cfa-frm-formula-sheets (⭐0) - Training Data - Machine-readable CFA Level I/II and FRM Part I formula reference in LaTeX and JSON/CSV with variable definitions and official topic weights.
  • EPSILON - Python - Open-source backtesting simulator with a 25-minute Assumption Clinic worksheet that teaches students to inspect backtest assumptions using published failed cases. GitHub (⭐204)

6. Awesome Vue

Components & Libraries / UI Components

  • CyteEditor (⭐0) - Rich text editor SDK with Word/Excel paste fidelity, built-in snapshot & version comparison, and official adapters for Vue 3, Vue 2, React, Svelte, Angular, and Vanilla JS.

7. Awesome Roadmaps

Infrastructure / Operations

  • Cloud Engineer Roadmap - Project-based AWS cloud engineering roadmap covering identity, networking, storage, deployment, infrastructure as code, and disaster recovery.
  • Wyrcan Engineering Roadmap (⭐17) - Text-first 12-stage engineering curriculum covering systems, DevOps, cloud architecture, and MLOps with interactive checkpoints.

AI / Machine Learning / Data Science

  • Machine Learning Roadmap - Self-study machine learning roadmap covering Python, mathematics, PyTorch, and ML foundations, with staged concept lists and study-time estimates.

Miscellaneous

  • Knowledge Navigator (⭐5) - Interactive learning map with goal-based roadmaps and chapter prerequisites across STEM and other disciplines.

Articles & Books

  • Frontend Framework Interview Preparation Roadmap - Guide mapping frontend interview preparation across JavaScript, React, Angular, and Vue, with 7, 14, and 30-day study plans.

8. Awesome Parasite

Scientific Journals

  • Bulletin de la Société de Pathologie Exotique - French journal on tropical medicine and public health. The journal ran from 1908 to 2020, when it was replaced by Médecine Tropicale et Santé Internationale. Full volumes are freely accessible from Université Paris Cité (1908-1966, v. 1-59), Gallica (1967-1997, v. 60-90), The Society archives (1994-2020, v. 87-113), and RevuesOnline (2010-2020, v. 103-113).

9. Awesome Go

Bot Building

  • Wisp (⭐13) - Event-driven trading framework for Go. Spot, perpetual futures, prediction markets. Multi-exchange (Bybit, Hyperliquid, Polymarket).

Advanced Console UIs

  • rummage (⭐0) - Cross-platform terminal file/folder picker with fuzzy search, multi-select, and a preview pane.

10. Open Source Mac Os Apps

👨‍💻 Development (54)

  • Blave Agent (⭐113) - Desktop workspace where your own Claude Code or Codex writes trading strategies, backtests them and runs them live on crypto exchanges.

    Languages: Python JavaScript

    Website: https://blave.org

    Screenshots

  • Higgs (⭐34) - Dashboard and chat app for the Higgs inference server: runs MLX models on Apple Silicon behind OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, routes to remote providers, and traces every request.

    Languages: Rust TypeScript

    Website: https://github.com/panbanda/higgs (⭐34)

    Screenshots

  • Superagent (⭐32) - Desktop app that gives coding agents like Claude Code and Codex a real browser to drive, an iOS Simulator to install and screenshot apps in, and a phone companion app for remote monitoring.

    Languages: TypeScript Swift

    Website: https://superagent.computer

🛠️ Utilities (222) / ✏️ Text (17)

  • Audio Priority Bar (⭐30) - Native macOS menu bar app that automatically switches to your highest-priority connected headphones, speakers, and microphone.

    Languages: Swift

    Website: https://github.com/camguillory/Audio-Priority-Bar (⭐30)

    Screenshots

  • OpenVoiceFlow (⭐23) - On-device voice dictation for macOS with local transcription and optional text cleanup.

    Languages: Swift Objective-C Python Shell

    Website: https://openvoiceflow.com

    Screenshots

  • BrowBro (⭐18) - Keyboard-first macOS menu bar app to open clicked links in the right browser or profile.

    Languages: Swift

    Website: https://browbro.tiagomoraes.cloud

    Screenshots

  • Devie AI Quota Tracker (⭐16) - Dashboard and macOS menu bar for tracking AI subscription quotas in one place (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor). Supports multi-accounts, notifications, and session-timer start optimization.

    Languages: Rust TypeScript

    Screenshots

  • KyttoMCP (⭐9) - Manage MCP servers across Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and Codex in one matrix, with health checks, a tool safety scan and local config backups.

    Languages: Swift

Tools

  • VPN Bypass - A Mac menu bar app that routes chosen sites around your VPN, or only those through it. (Source (⭐127))

Developer Tools

  • Device Hub Pro - Mirror and control Android emulators, phones, iOS simulators and iPhones side by side on your Mac. (Source (⭐136))
  • Orbi - Self-hosted AI agent that turns labelled GitHub issues into reviewed, merged pull requests and releases. (Source (⭐220))
  • SolidPing - Uptime monitoring with alerts and status pages, self-hosted as one server or on a free hosted plan. (Source (⭐17))

Games

  • Patzer - Self-hosted Chess.com alternative with game review, play vs Stockfish and an AI coach on your own model. (Source (⭐42))

Travel

  • Pumperly - Map of fuel prices and EV chargers that plans the cheapest stops on your route, free online or self-hosted. (Source (⭐44))

59. Awesome Django

Third-Party Packages / APIs

  • django-rest-knox (⭐1.3k) - Authentication Module for django-rest-auth.

Third-Party Packages / Configuration

  • django-constance (⭐1.9k) - A Django app for storing dynamic settings in pluggable backends (Redis and Django model backend built in) with an integration with the Django admin app.
  • django-content-settings (⭐59) - Easily create and manage editable typed variables directly from the Django admin panel.

Third-Party Packages / Files/Images

  • sorl-thumbnail (⭐1.8k) - Thumbnails for Django.

Third-Party Packages / Forms

  • django-formtools (⭐883) - For form previous and multistep forms, previously part of Django until 1.8.
  • django-widget-tweaks (⭐2.2k) - Tweak form field rendering in templates.

Resources / Official Resources

  • Django Software Foundation - The non-profit behind Django, open to individual members.
  • Bluesky - Official announcements on releases and security fixes.

Resources / Community

  • Discord Server - Django Discord Community.
  • Reddit - The r/django subreddit.
  • Stack Overflow - Questions tagged django.

Resources / Programs

  • Django Commons - The home for community-maintained Django packages.
  • Django Girls - Free one-day workshops introducing women to programming with Python and Django, run by volunteers worldwide.

Resources / Books

  • Django for Beginners, 6th Edition

60. Free for Dev

APIs, Data, and ML

  • cors.dev - CORS proxy for calling third-party APIs from frontend code: prefix any HTTPS URL with https://proxy.cors.dev/. Free without signup or an API key for GET and HEAD requests, 600 requests per minute per IP, responses up to 1 MiB, no monthly quota.
  • Dynamic Document API - Turn data into pixel-perfect PDFs and images. The free plan includes 50 renders per month and access to 2 templates from the template gallery or your own.

Tools for Teams and Collaboration

  • Enchant - Omnichannel customer communication platform. Free tier includes chat widgets, email newsletters, link-in-bio hub & more.
  • MergeMe - MergeMe brings GitHub/GitLab PRs/MRs directly into Slack as 1 constantly updating card. It adds CI status, mirrored comments, @mentions, reminders & more. Free for teams up to 5 developers & 1 channel mapping.

Authentication, Authorization, and User Management

  • Frontegg - Customer identity for B2B SaaS: authentication, SSO/SCIM, MFA, RBAC and multi-tenant user management. The free plan includes 7,500 MAUs

Monitoring

  • Monitorable - Server health monitoring for Linux (bare metal, VMs, LXC): host and Docker metrics, systemd services and SMART disk health, with alerting, OpenTelemetry Collector agent. Free for 3 servers, no card required.
  • OpenUptime - Hosted uptime monitoring and status pages. Free tier includes 3 active monitors with 5-minute check intervals, 26,000 checks and 100 emails per month, and 30 days of check history.

Education and Career Development

  • BylineCV - Form-based CV and cover letter builder to pass ATS filters and organize all your versions in one place. Free forever for core CV building, exports, and storage, with daily AI limits.

Email

  • DMARCmetric - DMARC report monitoring with named sending sources, SPF/DKIM alignment and plain-English summaries. Free for 1 domain: 10,000 messages/month, 30-day history, email alerts, no credit card.
  • SignupVet - An API that checks email, phone and IP of new signups. 250 free checks per month, no credit card.

Forms

  • BootForm - Form backend for builders. Free plan: 250 submissions a month with unlimited forms. Email and Discord notifications, honeypot/CAPTCHA, and an MCP server so AI coding agents can create and configure forms and manage submissions.

Web Hosting

  • Pagehaus - Hosting for plain HTML sites, uploaded over SFTP or in the browser. Free plan: 1 site, 250 MB storage, 20 GB transfer/month, HTTPS on a pagehaus.site subdomain, contact forms, Server Side Includes and cookie-free analytics. No expiry, no card.

Data Visualization on Maps

  • opengeocoding.com - Source-available geocoder in Rust: address search, autocomplete and reverse geocoding on open data. Self-host it or use the hosted API. Fifty thousand free queries/month.
  • waymorphic.com - Vector map tiles (OpenMapTiles schema), MapLibre styles, geocoding and reverse geocoding APIs. No API key, no request limit, fair use policy.

61. Awesome Mac

Reading and Writing Tools / Markdown Tools

  • MDViewer - Fast Markdown viewer with live reload, Quick Look previews, Mermaid, math and optional AI summaries with your own or a local model.

Developer Tools / IDEs

  • Threadlines - Open-source desktop app for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor), where several agents can share one thread and each thread gets its own git worktree.

Developer Tools / Developer Utilities

  • Eleven (⭐776) - Open-source reverse-engineering app where coding agents read, rename and patch binaries, Android apps and GPU kernels alongside you.

Developer Tools / API Development and Analysis

  • Optics Framework - Open-source UI test automation for Android, iOS, web and smart TV apps, with tests written as CSV or YAML steps.

Developer Tools / Virtualization

  • Mac Android Subsystem - Run Android apps on Apple Silicon, each in its own Mac window with its own Dock icon.

Developer Tools / Databases

  • DBine - Open-source database manager for 130+ SQL and NoSQL databases and cloud services, with notebooks, schema and data compare, and an MCP server.

Terminal Apps / Databases

  • SSHFire (⭐7) - Cross-platform SSH client with a terminal, a session manager and an SFTP browser that follows the current directory.

Design and Product / Screenshot Tools

  • Screenshots - Open-source menu bar tool for screenshots, scrolling capture, OCR, annotation, pinning, and MP4 or GIF screen recording, with no network code.

Design and Product / Other Tools

  • AI Canvas Tauri (⭐261) - Free, lightweight, source-available AI canvas for storyboarding, image and video creation, editing, and asset management with ComfyUI workflows.
  • Fotohaus (⭐0) - Open-source photo organizer that works on your existing folders, with on-device face recognition, search and non-destructive editing.

AI Tools / Other Tools

  • Atticus - Open-source voice assistant that runs on your Claude plan, learns new tasks after doing them once, and handles dictation, screen help, and background agents.
  • Cove - Open-source native composer, session sidebar and diff viewer for Claude Code and Codex, currently available as an Apple Silicon preview.
  • CoWork OS - Open-source desktop AI agent for files, browser, and chat-app tasks that works with your own API keys or local models.
  • Enconvo - AI agent that understands your screen and completes tasks across apps.
  • Godmode Bot - Open-source AI coworker that turns your Claude subscription into persistent agents that do computer work in their own browser with your logins.

Communication / Collaboration and Team Tools

  • FinchGram - Unofficial open-source Telegram client built on TDLib, with a screenshot tool, WebDAV downloads and opt-in MCP access for AI assistants.

Communication / File Sharing

  • FileShipper - Peer-to-peer file transfer between computers and phones over local Wi-Fi.
  • Nearby Drop - Independent macOS menu-bar app for two-way Google Quick Share transfers with compatible Android devices, plus USB MTP, Finder sharing, QR tools, and experimental Windows interoperability.

Audio and Video Tools / File Sharing

  • SoundCloud for macOS (⭐1) - Unofficial lightweight SoundCloud app for macOS.
  • TetherCam - Use an iPhone as a USB camera on a Mac for video only, or use the OBS plugin for video and the phone's microphone audio.

Audio and Video Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • PitchTap (⭐0) - Open-source menu bar app that changes the key of any app's audio live without changing the tempo.
  • Shiyin - Open-source meeting recorder that transcribes on-device, identifies speakers, and writes timestamped notes with your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription.

Download Management Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • Arroxy - Open-source yt-dlp GUI for downloading video, audio, playlists and subtitles from YouTube and other supported sites.

Voice-to-Text / Audio Record and Process

  • Voltip - Open-source push-to-talk dictation with on-device or cloud recognition, AI polish, and a paired Android phone as an optional microphone.

Browsers / Audio Record and Process

  • Stedding - Open-source Arc-style browser on Chromium with Spaces, vertical tabs, pinned folders, a command bar and Arc import.

Utilities / Audio Record and Process

  • Convertino (⭐11) - Drag a file, tap Shift and drop it on a radial menu to convert or edit it.

Utilities / Clipboard Tools

  • ClipRecallBar - Keyboard-first clipboard history popup that filters as you type and pastes with one key.
  • Clipstack - Native clipboard history with search, type filters, pins and optional iCloud sync.
  • Kurenai - Clipboard history with search, saved snippet lists and a paste queue that pastes copied items one by one. Skips passwords, history encrypted on disk.

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

  • Konverter (⭐7) - Menu bar file converter and image compressor operated by dragging files onto a radial wheel.
  • Kumquat (⭐2) - Menu bar file converter: drag files, tap Shift and drop them on a wheel to convert images, audio, video and documents, compress, OCR, trim and annotate.
  • Perch - Keyboard-first MacBook notch app for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and pi sessions: see what each did, answer from the notch, and jump back to the exact window or terminal pane.
  • Ledge - Turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island-style status area for now playing, timers, your next meeting, weather, notes, and Keep Awake (macOS 26+).
  • MenuBarMijia (⭐4) - Control Xiaomi Mi Home devices from the menu bar by voice or keyboard, via Mi Cloud QR login or Home Assistant (macOS 26+).
  • Topnotchers (⭐1) - Turns the MacBook notch into a home for Claude Code and Codex sessions as animated mascots, with questions and permission prompts answered from the notch.

Utilities / Cleanup and Uninstall

  • MacClean - Free local Mac disk cleaner that lets you review WeChat media, System Data, and Xcode or AI caches before deleting.
  • Peel - Free, open source uninstaller and cleaner that removes apps with every file they leave behind, shows you why each file belongs, and moves everything to the Trash, so you can put it back.
  • SpaceMap (⭐3) - Disk usage analyzer that draws your disk as a nested treemap you can zoom into, filling in live while the scan runs.

Utilities / File Organization Tools

  • Archivator (⭐4) - Menu bar archive tool that compresses and extracts files by dragging them onto a radial wheel.

Utilities / General Tools

  • Swivel (⭐24) - Tap a key mid-drag and drop files on a wheel to convert, crop, compress, strip metadata or share them, fully offline.

Utilities / Window Management

  • DockFlip - Dock window lists with browser tabs, a Flip 3D ⌘Tab window switcher and Windows-style snapping in one app.
  • KiwiDesk - Tiling window manager that works out of the box with no config file, has a native Settings app, and updates itself from inside the app.

Utilities / System Related Tools

  • Healthy Battery (⭐9) - Open-source charge limiter with live power flow and long-term battery health for Apple Silicon MacBooks.
  • IconCraft - Give any Mac app the name and icon you already know. The app underneath does not change.
  • WattMate - See which apps and AI coding agents are draining your MacBook battery, right from the menu bar, in real watts and the minutes you get back by quitting one.

Gaming Software / System Related Tools

  • Borne - Native front end for MAME and classic PC games (Doom, Quake, Duke Nukem 3D), in the spirit of MAMEUI, with the emulator and engines included.

Remote Login Software / System Related Tools

  • ClawTank (⭐8) - Open-source RDP server for connecting to a Mac from standard Remote Desktop clients like Windows App and mstsc.

QuickLook Plugins / System Related Tools

  • Folderglass - Quick Look extension for folders: real size including subfolders, file-type breakdown, largest and newest files, git branch and status, and the README rendered inline. Also previews zip contents and Markdown.
  • MD QuickLook (⭐0) - Native Quick Look extension for Markdown with syntax highlighting, math, and Mermaid diagrams, without a web engine.

62. Collective Ai Tools

Developer Tools

  • Frink - Desktop-first, open-source (MIT) application for running parallel agents, and multi-step custom workflows triggered by schedules, webhooks or events from tools like Linear and Sentry, across your already-used providers. #free #opensource
  • CodeTrendy - Curated directory of newly launched startups, SaaS and AI tools, with a free read-only remote MCP server (https://codetrendy.com/api/mcp) that lets AI assistants search listings, read profiles and find alternatives, no API key. #free #mcp
  • deed.page - Static hosting built for AI coding agents: one PUT (REST or remote MCP server) publishes HTML or a folder to a permanent HTTPS URL, with no account needed. #freemium #hosting
  • MEDIAPRONET - Launch and discovery directory where builders list newly shipped startups, SaaS tools and online products, with a free read-only remote MCP server (https://mediapronet.com/api/mcp) for searching listings, reading profiles and finding alternatives from AI assistants, no API key. #free #mcp

Design

  • APPLORE - AI app icon generator plus a library of 18,000+ real App Store and Google Play icons for reference. #freemium #design

Interior Designing

  • Spaceora - AI room and garden designer — redesign interiors, virtually stage, and plan landscapes from a single photo. #freemium

Productivity

  • Orkas - Turns project goals and local files into reports, presentations and code with a coordinated AI team in an open-source, local-first desktop workspace, using managed models or supported own-provider access. #opensource

Research

  • Pulse - AI-moderated market research platform that runs customer interviews at scale. #paid

Resume

  • HireDraftAI - AI-assisted resumes and cover letters with free anonymous tools for reviewing keywords and planning job applications. #freemium #writing

Video

  • pitchboom.io - Turns a product URL or a short brief into motion-design video ads with script, storyboard, voice-over and music, in 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 and 3:4. #freemium
  • Pixwit - Text-to-video, image-to-video and AI image generation with multiple models in one workspace. #freemium
  • Vidney - Multi-model AI video and image generator that runs 40+ models, including Kling, Veo, Seedance, Wan, Grok Imagine and Nano Banana, on one credit balance. #freemium

63. Awesome Raspberry Pi

Tools

  • EdgeLLM Bench - Leaderboard of local LLM speeds (tokens/sec) on Raspberry Pi 5, 4 and CM4 compared with Jetson and RK3588 boards, each result linked to its source.

Projects

  • Orbit OS - Android-like platform installed on top of Raspberry Pi OS: signed apps from an app store, atomic OTA updates, and Go, Python and Java SDKs to control GPIO, I²C, UART and the camera, with a VS Code extension (Orbit Studio) to run code live on the Pi and deploy in one click. Supports Raspberry Pi 3, 4, 5 and Zero 2 W.
  • Philosopher (⭐10) - A conversational-AI plush toy (Raspberry Pi + local LLM) that recognizes faces, reads emotions, remembers people, and talks with configurable personalities (100% local).
  • StickTime Pi (⭐1) - Raspberry Pi 4 FPV drone simulator for analog goggles, composite out into a 5.8 GHz video transmitter, flown with a real RC radio over WiFi, USB or Bluetooth.

64. Awesome Rust

Applications

  • alexandrosnt/Reach (⭐108) - Cross-platform SSH client for desktop and Android with SFTP, port forwarding, RDP, VNC and database tools, built with Tauri
  • datavzrd/datavzrd (⭐681) [datavzrd] - Create interactive HTML reports from CSV, TSV, JSON or Parquet tables with a simple YAML configuration
  • terraphim/terraphim-ai (⭐66) [terraphim-grep] - Local-first knowledge-graph search engine and privacy-preserving AI assistant: deterministic Aho-Corasick retrieval over role-based thesauri, native MCP server, agent session memory

Applications / Database

  • HasteHealth/HasteHealth (⭐84) - High-performance FHIR R4 clinical data repository (healthcare data server) built on Postgres
  • HeliosDatabase/HeliosDB-Nano (⭐10) [heliosdb-nano] - Embedded database with PostgreSQL and MySQL wire protocols, git-like branching, time-travel queries and HNSW vector search
  • PgCache/pgcache (⭐77) - A wire-compatible PostgreSQL caching proxy for repeated queries, kept fresh from the logical replication stream.

Applications / Games

  • 1homsi/thehumanbox (⭐55) - A browser civilization sandbox where tribes invent their own languages, cultures and beliefs, compiled to WebAssembly

Applications / Image processing

  • Hugo-Dz/spritefusion-sprite-normals (⭐113) - A CLI and WebAssembly tool that generates normal maps from pixel art sprites and animations (MIT).

Applications / MLOps

  • respanai/respan-gateway (⭐287) [respan-gateway] - LLM gateway that lets OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini SDKs call any model by translating between their APIs (chat, tools, media, realtime voice), with routing, fallback, an MCP tool loop and aggregator, and a web UI.

Applications / Productivity

  • runxhq/runx (⭐104) - Local runtime for agent skills with explicit authority, CLI and MCP access, and verifiable execution receipts.

Applications / System tools

  • AppachiTech/suvadu (⭐110) [suvadu] - Zsh and Bash history in a local SQLite database with exit codes, directories and the commands AI coding agents run, plus a read-only MCP server

Applications / Text editors

  • l0ng-ai/openidea (⭐53) - A native IDE with IntelliJ IDEA's keymap, tool windows and search-everywhere: editor, code insight, debugger, Git, terminal, database and HTTP clients for 60+ languages. Built with Tauri 2.

Applications / Web Servers

  • biandratti/huginn-proxy (⭐62) - Reverse proxy that forwards open-standard fingerprints (JA4 TLS, Akamai HTTP/2, and p0f TCP via an XDP/TC eBPF program) to backends as headers

Libraries / Cryptography

  • po0uyan/memsafe (⭐116) [memsafe] - Locked, sealed, zero-on-drop memory for secrets.

Libraries / Data processing

  • marcomq/mq-bridge (⭐24) [mq-bridge] - Async ETL and messaging library: config-driven routes move data between brokers (Kafka, NATS, AMQP, MQTT), databases incl. Postgres/MongoDB CDC, Parquet on S3/GCS/Azure, files and HTTP/gRPC, with retry, DLQ and deduplication middleware

Libraries / GUI

  • longbridge/gpui-kit (⭐18k) [gpui-component] - UI components for desktop applications using GPUI.

65. Awesome Go

Web Development / Template Engines

  • valyala/quicktemplate (⭐3.3k) — Fast template engine for Go ☆3,325

66. Awesome Ai

AI Coding Agents / General Purpose

  • benord-labs/frink (⭐89) — Desktop-first app for parallel agents and triggered multi-step workflows ☆171
  • orbi-build/orbi (⭐220) — Labeled GitHub issue to reviewed, merged PR and release ☆231

AI Coding Agents / Claude Code

  • yylo-dev/yylo (⭐65) — Command-line orchestrator for coding agents with typed task, validation, merge, and release-readiness boundaries ☆66

67. Awesome Mac

Developer Tools / Developer Utilities

  • ateymoori/oh-my-android (⭐60) — Control panel for the Android Emulator with one-click toggles and an MCP server ☆69

File Management / File Utilities

  • glimapp/glim (⭐24) — macOS file viewer for Markdown, PDFs, images, JSON, CSV and source code in one workspace. ☆29

🏆 Top 50 by Stars / Shell Utilities

  • agalwood/Motrix (⭐57k) — A full-featured download manager. ☆57,414

Security / System Security

  • RockxyApp/Shieldxy (⭐3) — Auditable application firewall and connection monitor for macOS ☆18

Window Management / Shell Utilities

  • tumingke0/LayoutKeeper (⭐23) — Restores window positions and Spaces when an external monitor is reconnected ☆25

entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Oct 19 - Oct 25, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Streaming

Table of Contents / Engines and Platforms

  • Clink (⭐5) - Embedded-first, Arrow-native stream processing engine with streaming SQL and exactly-once checkpoints.

Table of Contents / Applications and Tools

  • cdclint (⭐8) - Linter for the contract between Postgres migrations, a Debezium connector and the sink schema, failing the pull request that would silently drop a CDC column.

2. Awesome WSL

WSL Tools / WSL Utilities

  • Portable Linux in a Box (⭐7) - A ~252 KB C launcher that packages Linux web UIs, CLIs and dev servers as double-click Windows apps, auto-detecting WSL2 with QEMU/WHPX fallbacks.

3. Awesome Icons

General

  • Energy Icons (⭐12) - Open source icons for the energy transition and everyday UI, with 1,279 icons in two optical sizes and two weights. (Website)

4. Awesome Deno

Modules / Testing

  • keploy (⭐19k) - Record real traffic to generate integration tests and mock Postgres, Redis, and fetch calls.

Tools / XML

  • CompatLab (⭐4) - Check npm package loading across pinned Deno, Node.js and Bun versions with shareable reports.

5. Android Security Awesome

Tools / Misc Tools

  • SecureCheck (⭐4) - Open-source app that runs root, Frida, Xposed, tampering, Play Integrity, SSL pinning and other runtime checks, handy for testing bypass techniques against a known target

6. Urban and Regional Planning Resources

Platforms and Software Resources / Urban Design Tools and Platforms

  • AI Edit by TerraLab - A QGIS plugin that edits aerial and satellite imagery from a text prompt and returns a georeferenced layer.

7. Awesome Blazor

Videos / Others

  • .NET Day Online 2026, by JetBrains - October 7, 2026 - Escape the Monolith: Scaling Blazor with .NET Aspire and Azure Container Apps, with Michael Washington.
  • Blazor Community Standup: Build agentic experiences with the Blazor AI Components - October 6, 2026 - Modern AI applications are more than chat experiences. Learn how to use the new Blazor AI Components to build agent-centric apps where AI agents actively participate in the user experience, driving workflows, taking actions, and helping users get work done.
  • Blazor Hybrid: One UI for Web, iOS, Android & Desktop (.NET MAUI) - July 20, 2026 - Blazor Hybrid + .NET MAUI: build your UI once with Razor components and ship it to the browser, iOS, Android, Windows, and macOS – with full native API access from a single .NET codebase. David Ortinau, Principal Product Manager on the .NET team at Microsoft, breaks down how Blazor Hybrid works under the hood: Razor components hosted in a BlazorWebView, running in one .NET process with no web server on the device. He walks through the .NET MAUI Blazor Web App template, native platform concerns like Android safe areas, and real production-grade Blazor Hybrid apps – Sentence Studio (an AI-powered language learning app orchestrated with .NET Aspire), PolyPilot (an app the .NET MAUI team built entirely with AI agents), and MAUI Sherpa (an open-source toolbox for cross-platform developers). He also shares the .NET 11 roadmap: CoreCLR as the single runtime across platforms (WASM support still in progress), the path to Native AOT, .NET Watch everywhere, a unified Hot Reload pipeline, and MAUI DevFlow – tooling that gives AI coding agents eyes and hands inside your running app.

Articles / Others

  • Should I break down my Blazor page into multiple components? - October 6, 2026 - Article describing the pros and cons about breaking down a Blazor page into multiple components. *Build Agentic UI with the new Blazor AI components - September 28, 2026 - Build Agentic UI with the new Blazor AI components for streamed content, tools, approvals, shared state, and generative experiences.

8. GoBooks

Related Lists / Tuxerrante repo on go exercises

  • TypeScript Books (⭐189) - A curated, hand-picked list of the best TypeScript books for learning TypeScript.

9. Awesome Open Hardware

Projects / Automation, Manufacturing, and Robotics

  • Gearotons M17 (⭐14) - Integrated servomotor with the motor, driver, motion controller and encoder in one NEMA 17 body.
  • SO-ARM 102 (⭐138) - 3D-printable leader-follower robotic arm with a parallel gripper, open CAD files, a bill of materials, and assembly instructions.

Projects / Consumer Devices

  • Tiny Film Camera (⭐18) - Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W digital camera with physical controls, three selectable image filters, and a 3D-printable enclosure.

Platforms / Integrated Circuit

  • ICBOMS - Open electronic component search engine, BOM management platform, and semiconductor distribution database.
  • RoboPartPicker - Compiles bills of materials from open robotics projects and tracks parts sourcing, keeping unresolved and unpriced lines visible instead of dropping them.

Related Awesome / Integrated Circuit

  • Awesome KiCad Projects (⭐198) - Curated list of open source hardware projects whose PCBs are designed in KiCad.

10. Awesome Gif

General Tools

  • ImageMagick

11. Awesome Irc

Clients

  • Textual - Very customizable, ZNC integration, iCloud sync ($4.99). (source (⭐1.9k)) macOS
  • gamja - A simple IRC web client. Web
  • Goguma - An IRC client for mobile devices, from the creator of soju. (source) Android Linux

Channels / Platforms

  • #Ubuntu@Libera.Chat - Official Ubuntu support channel. (rules)

Miscellaneous / Platforms

  • img2irc (⭐46) - Convert images to halfblock ANSI or IRC, with a bunch of post-processing filters. Rust

12. Awesome D

Programming Languages / Status page

  • Ever (⭐5) - A High-Level Programming Language for Low-Level Purposes

13. Awesome Windows

Version Control

  • WinMerge - Visual diff and merge tool for files and folders.

14. Webcomponents the Right Way

Component Libraries

  • AWC UI (⭐17) - Material Design 3 component library built with Stencil and shipped as custom elements.
  • IconOven - 85,000+ UI Icons as a Web Component on One 24 px Grid, Free in the Stroke Style Under MIT.

15. Awesome AutoHotkey

Filesystem / Web

  • ALTRun (⭐188) - A lightweight, open-source Alfred-style launcher for Windows. For apps, files (with Everything), web searches, calculations, clipboard history and snippets. Written in AutoHotkey v2.

Typing / Web

  • AU accounting hotkeys (⭐0) - Types Australian financial year dates and period labels, with a searchable picker, ABN and ACN formatting and draft workpaper snippets.

16. Awesome Rails

Gems / Other external resources

  • rails_preflight (⭐10) - A gem to report what blocks upgrading a Rails app to a target version, before you change any code. 🔴

17. Awesome Algorand

Oracles / Visual Studio

  • Gora - Decentralized oracle networks that connect the Algorand Blockchain with the real world.

18. Awesome Nextjs

Boilerplates

  • GenPM Kits - Next.js kits (store, blog, CMS, landing, dropshipping) installed as source code you own, with Stripe, Drizzle and auth wired in and rules for your AI agent.

Apps

  • Looot Network (⭐0) - Open source alternative to Happenstance: search your own LinkedIn, Google Contacts or CSV network in plain language. Built with Next.js 16 and Supabase, MIT, with a demo mode; optional paid enrichment needs a looot API key.
  • Vizz.fm - Browser-based music visualizer built with Next.js, Three.js, and the Web Audio API.

19. Awesome Dataviz

R tools / Misc

  • r2d3 (⭐529) - Renders custom D3.js visualizations from R, in RStudio, R Markdown and Shiny.

Websites / Misc

35. Static Analysis

Programming Languages / Other

  • phploc ⚠️ — A tool for quickly measuring the size and analyzing the structure of a PHP project.

Multiple languages / Other

  • Kimün — Code health metrics from the terminal. Grades a project from A++ to F-- on cognitive complexity, duplication, indentation, Halstead effort and file size, and lists the files to look at first. Separate commands report cyclomatic and cognitive complexity per function, duplicates, code smells and the Maintainability Index. From git history it finds hotspots, code ownership and temporal coupling, and measures which files a diff reaches. A CI gate fails when a changed file gets worse.

Other / Other

  • compose-lint — Security linter for Docker Compose files. Checks compose.yaml against 27 rules taken from the OWASP Docker Security Cheat Sheet and the CIS Docker Benchmark: mounted Docker socket, privileged mode, missing no-new-privileges, extra capabilities, writable root filesystem, ports bound to all interfaces, credentials in environment variables, unpinned images. Each finding says how to fix it and which runtime error the fix can cause. JSON and SARIF output, a GitHub Action, and a dry-run auto-fix.
  • GitStats (⭐94) — Generates a static HTML report from a Git repository's history: activity, authors, code ownership, hotspots and bus factor, file churn, tags and lines of code over time. It also counts the commits that name an AI coding assistant (agent accounts, Co-authored-by and Assisted-by lines). Works on any Git repository with only git and Python, writes JSON, compares several repositories, and runs as a GitHub Action.

54. Awesome Gemini Cli

Interfaces

  • Yaw - Cross-platform terminal that auto-detects Gemini CLI and opens a split-pane workflow with a companion terminal.
  • Termly - Free native iOS and Android app to monitor and control Gemini CLI (and other CLI AI assistants) remotely. Zero-knowledge E2E encryption, pairs in under 60 seconds via QR code. No subscriptions, no usage limits.
  • AnywhereDesign - Local-first voice cockpit and remote mobile interface for Claude Code & Antigravity/Gemini CLI. Control terminal agent sessions from your phone via local QR code, real-time voice dictation, live terminal output streaming, and zero-token mobile Git sync.
  • Mobile SSH - Android and iOS (TestFlight beta) SSH client for running Gemini CLI on remote servers, with a Gemini CLI installer plugin, simultaneous terminal sessions, and tmux session management.
  • Bellows - Desktop workspace that runs Gemini CLI over ACP alongside Claude and Codex, with diffs, permission prompts, team rules, a hash-linked audit trail and live session sharing. Windows, macOS and Linux.

Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

  • Tars - A local-first autonomous supervisor and sidekick powered by Google Gemini. Features background persistence (heartbeat), tiered local memory, multi-channel notifications (Discord/WhatsApp), and self-healing background services. Designed for reliable, long-running agentic orchestration in the terminal.
  • VibeFuse - Free Windows desktop harness that runs Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Qwen as live draggable widgets on one canvas, with named sessions, local Whisper/Piper voice, an MCP tool panel, and a marketplace where skill and widget sellers keep 80% (Stripe Connect).
  • Drevon - Mac app that connects to your Claude Code or Codex and turns it into an end-to-end GTM operator: research, grunt work, analysis and actions across your stack from a single prompt, in your own browser with your own logins.
  • magents (⭐14) - Gemini CLI extension, MCP server and CLI over the session transcripts Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Grok and OpenCode already write. List and read other live sessions, hand off compact state, send into a specific chat, or spawn a headless session that replies through a shared inbox. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/abnegate/magents. Rust, MIT.
  • SpaceApp (⭐14) - Self-hosted web workspace that runs Gemini CLI alongside OpenCode, Codex, Claude Code and other coding CLIs as side-by-side panes in persistent rooms, with MCP servers and managed browser panes. Install: npx --yes run-spaceapp@latest install. Source-available (BSL 1.1).

Commands & Extensions

  • brethof-brain (⭐1) - Gemini CLI extension for the hosted brethof-brain memory: with every prompt, the records that bear on it arrive before Gemini answers; a brief at session start; every turn archived; the same memory is shared with Claude Code, Codex and other agents. Needs a brethof-brain account (free plan). Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/BrethofAI/brethof-brain-client.
  • PostEverywhere (⭐0) - Social media scheduler for Gemini CLI. Write, schedule and publish posts to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Threads, Pinterest and Bluesky, and plan a content calendar. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/posteverywhere/gemini-cli-extension (posteverywhere.ai).
  • MoltNode by Chord (⭐0) - Gemini CLI extension that connects two hosted MCP servers and a GEMINI.md context file: MoltNode for JSON-RPC reads on 31 blockchains, and Chord for DEX swap quotes and unsigned swap transactions on Base, Monad, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Robinhood Chain and Arc, plus token boards, candles and wallet PnL. No API key; the agent's own wallet signs every transaction. MIT. Install via gemini extensions install https://github.com/tuantqse90/moltnode-mcp.
  • Thinking Methods (⭐15) - Curated Agent Skills (SKILL.md) for structured thinking on real decisions: five whys, pre-mortem, trade-offs, prioritization, six thinking hats, and twelve more methods plus a selector skill. Install as a Gemini extension (gemini extensions install https://github.com/ysskrishna/ai-agent-skills) or skills only (gemini skills install https://github.com/ysskrishna/ai-agent-skills.git --path skills). MIT.
  • Kuudo Skills (⭐2) - Gemini CLI extension with 22 Agent Skills for Amazon sellers and advertisers: Sponsored Products and Brands audits, search-term mining, budget pacing, DSP and Amazon Marketing Cloud, listings, product images, repricing, FBA inbound, and profitability, built for Kuudo's hosted Amazon Ads and SP-API MCP servers. Price, budget, listing, and shipment writes are previewed and wait for your approval. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/KuudoAI/skills. PolyForm Shield 1.0.0 (source-available).

Development Tools & Utilities

  • IssueDB - LLM frendly command-line issue tracking system for software development projects, with built-in interface, context support and prompt providers for Gemini CLI and others.
  • MCP Config Doctor - Browser-local diagnostic that validates Gemini CLI ~/.gemini/settings.json MCP server entries (shape, env/secret references, transport fields). Also covers Claude Code, Codex CLI, and VS Code MCP configs. No account, no telemetry, no remote calls — runs entirely in the browser.
  • Usage HUD - Native macOS menu-bar meter that shows your Gemini CLI usage window next to Claude, Codex, Grok and Ollama, with a confidence label on every number. Paid, $9.
  • Agent Cat - Free macOS/Windows menu-bar app that shows Gemini CLI and Antigravity usage and limits next to Claude Code and Codex, read from local files.
  • Awakado - macOS menu-bar app that keeps the Mac awake while Gemini CLI is working, using Gemini CLI hooks, and lets it sleep when it finishes. Also supports Claude Code, Codex and other agents. Free, with a paid Pro tier.
  • SkillKeeper - macOS menu bar app that reads local Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions to show which skills, agents, MCP servers and tools ran, how often, and what they cost in tokens. Native Swift, free to track.
  • MacMD Viewer - Read-only Markdown viewer for macOS 14+ for the GEMINI.md and plan files Gemini CLI writes. Renders Mermaid diagrams and highlighted code, reloads when the file changes on disk, and adds Quick Look previews in Finder. Paid, $19.99 one-time.
  • Check (⭐0) - Extension with a BeforeTool hook that checks each file write on your own machine before Gemini CLI makes it (and, on Linux, each shell command): files, folders, programs, git refs and packages it names must exist, and scripts must parse; what the machine proves wrong is blocked with the machine's message. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/golproductions/check-gemini. Paid, 14-day free trial.
  • tokenreceipt (⭐1) - Local CLI that reads Gemini CLI chat logs (plus Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other agents) and prints a till-style receipt of tokens per agent and model, priced at public API list prices. Exports SVG/PNG cards or JSON; no account, no upload, no dependencies. MIT. Run: npx github:henrikdukefoss/tokenreceipt.
  • Wardlume - Locks the Mac's keyboard, mouse, and trackpad while Gemini CLI runs unattended, so progress stays visible but nobody can type into the session. Unlocks with Touch ID or Apple Watch; sandboxed with no network access.
  • session-handoff-kit (⭐0) - Agent Skill (open SKILL.md standard; installs into Gemini CLI with npx skills add alapha888/session-handoff-kit --agent gemini-cli) that ends a session with a structured handoff — goal state, decisions, files touched, open loops, next action — so the next session starts from facts instead of an over-full context. Also includes a context-hygiene checklist and a fill-in handoff template. MIT.
  • agy-powerline (⭐15) - Fast, configurable statusline for Antigravity CLI (agy), the successor to Gemini CLI, with real-time 5h/7d Gemini quota meters, pace markers, context usage, and interactive TUI editor. Zero dependencies, MIT.
  • agentvcr (⭐2) - Turns a Gemini CLI chat from ~/.gemini/tmp/*/chats (the JSONL format with rewinds and patches, or the older JSON files) into a self-contained HTML replay with a scrubbable timeline, diffs and terminal output, with API keys and other secrets masked locally first. Share it as a link through a secret gist on your own GitHub, embed it, export a Markdown transcript for a pull request, or have its GitHub Action comment the replay on agent PRs. Also reads Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode. MIT, no dependencies. Run: npx agentvcr-cli.

  • Aident Loadout - Connects Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other MCP clients to your apps and 400+ expert-built Skills through one remote MCP server, CLI or Skill, with credentials kept in a vault and every action logged. #freemium #mcp
  • Archcore (⭐71) - Git-native context engineering and spec-driven development for AI coding agents. #free #opensource
  • CurlShot - Screenshot API that captures any URL, HTML, or Markdown as PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF, or scrolling video, with a hosted MCP server so AI agents can take screenshots. Free plan with 100 screenshots/month. #freemium #api #mcp
  • Jet Browser (⭐2) - Portable WPE WebKit runtime for agents with isolated Docker sessions, native input, DOM/text reads, fresh screenshots, and ordered JSONL, MCP, and JavaScript SDK interfaces. #free #opensource
  • Masaka for Codex (⭐1) - Local macOS and Linux CLI that keeps each ChatGPT account and workspace in an isolated CODEX_HOME, shows Codex usage windows, and switches future native Codex sessions without copying tokens. #free #opensource
  • Omega MCP Router (⭐1) - Stdio MCP proxy that runs many MCP servers behind one connection, serving tool schemas from a disk cache and starting each server only on its first call. #free #mcp
  • ShellWire - Software discovery directory with explainable utility rankings, source-backed tool comparisons, and a remote Streamable HTTP MCP server for AI assistants. #free
  • The Enso Method (⭐5) - Agent skills for Claude Code and Codex that record business assumptions with evidence and confidence, and preserve requirements as the source of truth. #free #opensource

Human Resources

  • CareJobs.Now - Free AI job search for US healthcare workers: describe the job you want in plain words and it matches you to 170,000+ hospital and clinic jobs with posted pay. #free

Image Editing

  • BatchSet - Remove image backgrounds with AI right in your browser, then convert, compress or resize whole folders at once. Free without signup. #freemium

Image Generator

  • Muse Studio - Generates static ad concepts from text with editable headline, offer and CTA, and PNG export. Limited free beta; ChatGPT sign-in; no card. #free #design

Models

  • ArtificialWatch - AI model release tracker that checks provider APIs every 60 seconds and alerts you by email, push, SMS or phone call when a new model goes live. #freemium

SEO

  • AltoRank - Open-source SEO content software that researches what your buyers search for and drafts sourced articles; self-host it free or use the hosted version. #freemium #seo #opensource
  • Blawgy - Writes and publishes SEO blog posts to WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Wix, Framer, Ghost and Duda, with an MCP server so any AI agent can research keywords, manage the plan and publish. #paid #seo

Social Media

  • OpenSparta - Discover relevant audiences, manage Telegram accounts, and streamline engagement from one workspace. #freemium #social-media

Summarizer

  • ORANO - Turns saved Reels, TikToks, YouTube videos, articles and PDFs into searchable summaries and step-by-step plans. #freemium

Video

  • Sora2 Hub - AI image and video generation platform for text-to-video, image-to-video and text-to-image in one workspace. #freemium

65. Awesome Ai

Generators / App

  • ysy0915/chat-system (⭐16) — Multi-AI group chat system with debate, RAG, knowledge graph and Multi-Agent workflow ☆17

1. Awesome Openstreetmap

Public APIs / Java

  • MapAtlas - REST API for geocoding, routing, isochrone, matrix, map matching, and MVT vector tiles built on OpenStreetMap data. (Docs)

4. Awesome Tmux

7. Awesome Godot

Projects / Godot 4

  • MSDF Atlas Studio (⭐2) - High-performance desktop studio for generating multi-channel signed distance field (MSDF) font texture atlases with live shader preview.

8. Awesome Framer

Other

  • Checkout Page - Native plugin for selling digital products, subscriptions, and event tickets on your Framer site through your own Stripe account.

9. Awesome Cl

Mobile

  • Evergreen-Compose (⭐2) - Build native Android apps in Evergreen Common Lisp, using Jetpack Compose and Material 3. GPL-3.0-or-later WITH Classpath-exception-2.0.
    • Evergreen Compose supplies a shared, precompiled Android runtime. Application builds require EGCL and egcl-target-android (runtime API 4), no JDK, Kotlin compiler, Gradle, Android SDK or NDK.
    • Develop inside the running app. Connect Emacs with SLY or icl to the phone's Lisp image through an ADB-forwarded Slynk port. Evaluate Lisp, inspect application state, and update the running UI without rebuilding or reinstalling the APK

Work in progress

  • LCL - Lua Common Lisp - Lua Common Lisp is an implementation of Common Lisp targeting the Lua language. The goal of this project is to provide an implementation of Common Lisp that can be used wherever an unmodified Lua VM is running.
  • (LLM) Evergreen (⭐21): Evergreen is Common Lisp with a HotSpot-inspired native runtime, built from scratch in Rust. It starts executing in bytecode, compiles hot code to native instructions, and specializes dynamically typed programs as they run.
    • new as of Oct, 2026
    • warning: this is an experiment. The parts that do work may not behave the way you expect, or the way the standard says they should. It may never work.
    • Lightweight fibers with synchronous socket I/O
    • Native interoperability (C, JVM, Python)
    • Standalone applications and saved images.
    • The default x86-64 Linux build is fully static
    • Tree shaking of Lisp and Rust
    • Native Android applications with Slime-style development: see evergreen-compose (⭐2)
    • Core code, test suites, and documentation were almost entirely generated by AI assistants following high-level human prompts and specification. Conceptual architecture, prompt direction, and repository orchestration (minimal manual code review or line-by-line verification).
