12. Awesome Chrome Devtools

Tracing & Profiling

  • trace.cafe - Share and view web performance traces directly in the DevTools Performance panel (source (⭐142)).
  • speedscope (⭐6.8k) - Fast, interactive flamegraph viewer that imports Chrome .cpuprofile and timeline traces.
  • cpupro (⭐788) - Deep V8/Chrome .cpuprofile analyzer with flamegraphs, call trees, and hot-spot diagnostics.
  • Perfetto (⭐6.6k) - System profiling and trace analysis suite (ui.perfetto.dev) with Chromium trace support and SQL trace querying.

Chrome DevTools Protocol / The big two automation libraries

  • Puppeteer (⭐96k) - High-level Node.js API for controlling Chrome over CDP and WebDriver BiDi. See also awesome-puppeteer (⭐2.6k).

Chrome DevTools Protocol / Libraries for driving the protocol (or a layer above)

  • Rust: chromiumoxide (⭐1.4k) - Async/tokio library with generated types
  • Rust: Rust Headless Chrome (⭐3k) - High-level headless Chrome client
  • Python: Zendriver (⭐1.5k) - Async CDP browser automation
  • Ruby: Ferrum (⭐2.1k) - High-level API to control Chrome
  • Ruby: Cuprite (⭐1.4k) - Capybara driver
  • Kotlin: kdriver (⭐108) - High-level coroutine-based automation

Chrome DevTools Protocol / Agentic Browser Automation

  • chrome-devtools-mcp (⭐53k) - Official MCP server for Chrome DevTools, which also includes a CLI (⭐53k).
  • Webcmd (⭐2.6k) - Compiles site navigation into deterministic per-site CLI commands for AI agents.
  • bdg (⭐152) - Persistent background CDP session exposing DOM, network, console, and raw protocol methods as shell commands.

Using DevTools frontend with other platforms / Browser Adapters

  • ChromeDevTools/devtools-frontend (⭐4.1k) - Canonical source repo for the Chrome DevTools UI (published to npm as chrome-devtools-frontend).
  • Chii (⭐2.2k) & Eruda (⭐21k) - Remote debugging server using the real devtools-frontend UI (Chii, a modern Weinre replacement) and in-page mobile DevTools console (Eruda).
  • vscode-js-debug (⭐2k) - Official DAP-compliant JavaScript and Chrome CDP debugger powering VS Code.

DevTools Extensions / Browser Adapters

  • Vue.js Developer Tools (⭐2.9k) - Inspect Vue.js components, state, and routing.

Alumni / Browser Adapters

  • noice-json-rpc (⭐46) - Proxy-based TypeScript/JS library exposing CDP domains directly as an API.

13. Awesome Ada

Open source / GPL (with linking exception)

  • gnat-patches (⭐0) - Curated GCC/GNAT patchsets against checksum-pinned upstream sources, each backed by an executable regression, published as patched native toolchain builds for GCC 13 through 16.

Runtimes / GPL (no linking exception)

  • flyology (⭐9) - Experimental GNAT runtime extension for ordinary Ada tasking, adding task-aware I/O and an opt-in lightweight lane that runs designated tasks as fibers on shared event loops.

Distributed / GPL (no linking exception)

  • ipfs (⭐0) - InterPlanetary File System client library: CID/multihash/multibase, CAR archives with block verification, trustless HTTP gateway client.

Terminal User Interface / GPL (no linking exception)

  • flyology-tui (⭐0) - Typed, declarative terminal user-interface toolkit for Ada.

Database / GPL (no linking exception)

  • flyology-postgres (⭐0) - Client and server primitives for the PostgreSQL frontend/backend protocol, built on flyology (⭐9) task-aware I/O.

Web / GPL (no linking exception)

  • flyology-http (⭐0) - HTTP/1.1 clients and servers with opt-in HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 engines and WebSocket support, built on flyology (⭐9) task-aware I/O.

Algorithms, Containers and Protocols / GPL (no linking exception)

  • flyology-allocators (⭐9) - Caller-owned buddy, best-fit, TLSF, and slab/span allocation algorithms with no hosted operating system dependency.
  • flyology-cachelines (⭐9) - Cache-line-aware storage, ownership-aware groups, grouped arrays, and host cache queries.

Format Readers, Writers and Checkers / GPL (no linking exception)

  • flyology-iri (⭐0) - Allocation-conscious URI, IRI, and WHATWG URL parsing.
  • flyology-rdf (⭐0) - RDF 1.2 terms, streaming Turtle, TriG, N-Triples and N-Quads parsing, RDFC-1.0 dataset canonicalization, Notation3, and SPARQL 1.1 query syntax.

Networking and Communication Middleware / GPL (no linking exception)

  • flyology-quic (⭐0) - Experimental bounded QUIC transport with protocol state, streams, loss recovery, and congestion control.

General Purpose Computing / GPL (no linking exception)

  • flyology-simd (⭐0) - Portable, strongly typed SIMD foundations for Ada.

Utilities / GPL (no linking exception)

  • flyology-bench (⭐9) - Adaptive microbenchmarking with balanced comparisons, diagnostics, baselines, and machine-readable reports.
  • flyology-debug (⭐9) - Bounded in-memory tracing, producer shards, retained batches, and persistent gauges.

Linux and POSIX / GPL (no linking exception)

  • flyology-numa (⭐9) - Memory-node topology reporting, memory placement on a chosen node, and node-bound storage pools.

14. Awesome Embedded Rust

Tools / Paid and commercially available materials

Firmware projects / WIP

  • oreboot (⭐1.8k): platform initialization firmware (first code to run) to bring up application processors, a fork of coreboot with no C, all written in Rust, leveraging Rust Embedded traits and crates

Business

Plugins / IRC

Tools / IRC

Packagist-compatible repositories / IRC

  • WordPress Packages - Composer repository for WordPress.org plugins and themes.
  • WP Sec Adv (⭐27) - Composer repository for WordPress security advisories.

17. Awesome Preact

Contents / Boilerplates

Contents / Components

  • @zikojs/preact-console (⭐22) - A console-like UI component for Preact that renders JavaScript console output directly inside your application.

18. Awesome Cytodata

🌟 Purpose

  • Centralize Knowledge: Provide a "one-stop shop" for foundational and state-of-the-art research.
  • Lower Entry Barriers: Help new researchers navigate "Influential Papers" selected by the community.
  • Promote Open Science: Highlight publicly available datasets and open-source pipelines.
  • Standardize Discovery: Offer a professional, searchable index for DOIs and software repositories.

🚀 Key Features / 📚 The Literature Corpus

  • Advanced Search: Real-time fuzzy searching via Fuse.js across titles, authors, journals, and abstracts.
  • Author Formatting: Scientific citation style (Lastname, F. et al.) for professional scanning.
  • Filtering: Sort by year, category (Methods, Biology, Reviews, etc.), or influential status.
  • Direct Access: One-click DOI links to publisher pages.

🚀 Key Features / 💾 Dataset Index

  • A curated table of massive public releases like the Cell Painting Gallery, JUMP-CP, and RxRx.
  • Filterable by description and reference paper.

🚀 Key Features / 🛠️ Software Directory

  • Catalog of community-standard tools including CellProfiler, DeepProfiler, and PyCytominer.
  • Categorized by purpose (Feature Extraction, Data Engineering, etc.).

🛠️ Technical Architecture / 🛠️ Software Directory

  • Frontend: React 19+ (ESM-based via CDN for zero-install development).
  • Styling: Tailwind CSS for a clean, academic aesthetic.
  • Search Engine: Fuse.js for client-side fuzzy indexing of JSON data.
  • Data Layer: Flat JSON files in /data/ acting as a "Local Database" for easy community contributions.
  • Deployment: Automated GitHub Actions workflow for validation and hosting.

🤝 Contributing / 🛠️ Software Directory

  • Read the CONTRIBUTING.md guide.
  • Run python3 scripts/add_resource.py paper or python3 scripts/add_resource.py dataset to add your entry (or edit the JSON files in public/data/ by hand).
  • Open a Pull Request.

19. Awesome Gdpr

Training and awareness (art. 39)

  • RansomLeak GDPR Training - Interactive exercises on lawful bases, DSAR handling, breach response, DPIA, records of processing, and cross-border transfers.

Tools

  • consentprobe (⭐0) - CLI and GitHub Action that tests whether a website stops tracking after the visitor rejects cookies.
  • disclosedby - Dated record of the subprocessor lists software companies publish under art. 28, with what changed and when; open JSON, Markdown and an MCP server.

Related

  • PIPEDA vs GDPR: What Canadian Companies Must Know - Comparison of Canadian and EU privacy regulations for companies operating in both jurisdictions.

20. Awesome Executable Packing

📚 Literature / Scientific Research

  • 🎓 Building a smart and automated tool for packed malware detection using machine learning (June 2020)

🔧 Tools / Before 2000

  • XVolkolak (⭐4) - Qt/CMake emulator-unpacker project with a GUI and a console application.

Concurrency

  • Kaspar-HFT (⭐33) - A C++20 actor framework and trading system with synchronous message delivery (fast_send), order-book reconstruction and a queue-exact replay simulator. [MIT]

Image Processing

  • FreeImageRe (⭐31) - A fork of FreeImage to support latest image codecs and adjust for modern compilers. All original formats and plugins are maintained. [GPLv2, GPLv3, FIPL]

Coding Style Tools

  • cpp-linter-hooks (⭐50) - Pre-commit hooks for C/C++ powered by clang-format and clang-tidy. [MIT]

22. Awesome Dotfiles

  • Dotfiles and dev tools provisioned by Ansible

Find dotfiles repos / Using specific tools

  • Archlinux collection

  • GNU Stow - Symlink farm manager which takes distinct packages of software and/or data located in separate directories on the filesystem, and makes them appear to be installed in the same place.

  • osxc

23. Awesome Qgis

Plugins / Analysis and Processing

  • AI Agent by TerraLab - Describe a GIS task in plain words; the agent finds open data, runs Processing tools, styles the map and builds the print layout, with one-click undo. Freemium, free tier.

24. Awesome Cli Apps

Development / Chat

  • herdr-reviewr (⭐823) - Review a coding agent's diff and send line comments back to it.

25. Awesome Developer First

Databases & Spreadsheets

26. Awesome Rails

DevTools / Other external resources

  • Keploy - Generates Rails integration tests from real traffic and replays ActiveRecord, Redis, and HTTP calls as mocks.

Gems / Other external resources

  • solid_objects (⭐40) - A gem for SQL-backed virtual actors: durable state, ordered calls, and reminders in the app's SQLite, PostgreSQL, or MySQL database (pre-1.0). 🔴

27. Awesome Algorithms

Beginner-Friendly / Interactive Learning & Visualization

  • DSA View View - Runs your own TypeScript algorithm functions in the browser and shows arrays, matrices, trees, linked lists, stacks, and pointers changing step by step, with built-in LeetCode-style examples.

28. Awesome D

Build Tools / Status page

  • rules_d (⭐27) - Bazel rules and toolchains for building D libraries, binaries, tests, protocol buffers, and projects that depend on DUB packages.
  • gazelle_d (⭐0) - Gazelle extension for generating Bazel build files from D sources and DUB manifests.

29. Awesome Windows

Security

30. Webcomponents the Right Way

Shadow DOM

  • Web Components: Working With Shadow DOM

CSS Shadow Parts

Component Libraries

  • Accesserty UI Kit (⭐2) - HTML-first accessible web components with built-in keyboard behavior, state handling, and i18n. No runtime dependencies.
  • Marvelous UI (⭐1) - Framework-agnostic custom elements and CSS components with design tokens and no runtime dependencies.

Web Platform Tests

  • wpt/custom-elements (⭐6.2k)
  • wpt/shadow-dom (⭐6.2k)
  • wpt/css-shadow (⭐6.2k)
  • wpt/template-element (⭐6.2k)

31. Awesome Nextjs

Apps

  • Ceramic Coating Near Me - Independent directory and publication built with Next.js for finding ceramic-coating shops in the United States and understanding coating options.

32. Awesome Dataviz

JavaScript tools / Charting libraries

  • Apache ECharts (⭐67k) - Highly customizable and interactive charts ready for big datasets.
  • billboard.js (⭐6k) - Reusable D3.js-based chart library with SVG and Canvas rendering, maintained by NAVER.
  • C3.js (⭐9.3k) - D3-based reusable chart library.
  • Cal-Heatmap (⭐3.1k) - Time-series calendar heatmaps, similar to GitHub's contribution graph, built on D3.
  • Carbon Charts (⭐1.1k) - Chart library from IBM's Carbon Design System, built on D3, with React, Angular, Vue and Svelte wrappers.
  • chart.xkcd (⭐7.9k) - Chart library that renders line, bar, pie and other charts in a hand-drawn xkcd style.
  • ChartGPU (⭐3.2k) - WebGPU charting library for large datasets, real-time streaming and multi-chart dashboards.
  • Charts.css (⭐6.6k) - CSS framework that styles HTML tables as charts.
  • DHTMLX Gantt (⭐1.9k) - Gantt chart component for project schedules, with task dependencies and drag-and-drop editing.
  • ECharts GL (⭐2.7k) - Extension for Apache ECharts that adds 3D plots, globe visualizations and WebGL-accelerated series.
  • Flot (⭐5.9k) - jQuery plotting library for line, bar and pie charts with zooming and other interactive features.
  • Frappe Charts (⭐15k) - Simple, responsive SVG charts with zero dependencies.
  • Frappe Gantt (⭐6.1k) - Simple, interactive SVG Gantt chart library.
  • G2 (⭐13k) - An interactive and responsive charting library based on the grammar of graphics, maintained by Alibaba.
  • heatmap.js (⭐6.4k) - Canvas-based library for rendering heatmaps, with plugins for Leaflet and Google Maps.
  • roughViz (⭐7.2k) - Sketchy, hand-drawn style charts for the browser, based on Rough.js.
  • TOAST UI Chart (⭐5.4k) - Complete library with support for legacy browsers.
  • Unovis (⭐2.9k) - Modular data visualization framework for React, Angular, Svelte, Vue and vanilla TypeScript, by F5.
  • uPlot (⭐11k) - Small, fast canvas-based charts for time series, lines, areas, OHLC and bars.
  • VChart (⭐1.8k) - Cross-platform charting library with animation and storytelling features, from ByteDance's VisActor.

JavaScript tools / Charting libraries for graphs

  • 3d-force-graph (⭐6.4k) - 3D force-directed graph component using Three.js/WebGL.
  • cosmos.gl (⭐1.3k) - GPU-accelerated force graph layout and rendering engine that runs entirely in WebGL shaders.
  • dagre (⭐5.8k) - Directed graph layout library for JavaScript.
  • elkjs (⭐2.8k) - Eclipse Layout Kernel (ELK) graph layout algorithms for JavaScript.
  • force-graph (⭐2.1k) - Force-directed graph component rendered on HTML5 canvas.
  • JointJS (⭐5.4k) - SVG-based JavaScript diagramming library for interactive diagrams and graph editors.
  • Viz.js (⭐4.3k) - Graphviz compiled to WebAssembly for rendering DOT graphs in the browser and Node.js.
  • Vue Flow (⭐6.9k) - Flowchart and node-based graph component for Vue 3.
  • X6 (⭐6.7k) - Diagramming library for DAGs, ER diagrams, flowcharts and other graph editors, maintained by Alibaba.

63. Awesome Gemini Cli

Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

  • puenteo (⭐1) - Gemini CLI extension + MCP server that lets Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions on one machine search each other's history and message each other live (send/wait/reply, channels, file claims). Local SQLite, no daemon.
  • Mudroom (⭐11) - Runs Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Aider and opencode inside a Linux micro-VM on a copy-on-write clone of your project, with a network allowlist and a pull-request-style diff review before changes are applied.
  • DHI Orbit (⭐1) - Local web dashboard that lists Gemini CLI and Antigravity chats alongside Claude Code, Codex and Cursor on one board, with what needs an answer and a reply box (gemini --resume <id> -p). Python standard library only, MIT.
  • Crewly (⭐89) - MIT-licensed, local platform that runs a team of role-based agents (developer, QA, PM, orchestrator) on Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Codex, with task delegation through agent skills, shared persistent memory, and a web dashboard of live agent terminals. Requires one of these agent CLIs installed and logged in.

Commands & Extensions

  • Supercov (⭐156) - Coverage, security and code quality for coding agents. Gemini CLI extension that runs the project's existing tests, measures line, branch and MC/DC coverage, and hands Gemini the untested code to test next. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/supercorp-ai/supercov.
  • figma-maxxing (⭐11) - Gemini CLI extension with 8 skills for agents editing real Figma files: Plugin API gotchas, checks before and after every write, comments to verified fixes, and a handoff gate. Built on figma-console-mcp; 3 of the checks also ran once on Figma's official MCP server. MIT. Install via gemini extensions install https://github.com/thiagoxikota/figma-maxxing.
  • NotWorking (⭐2) - Downdetector for AI agents: a skill and remote MCP server that checks whether other agents report the same site, skill or MCP server failure, and takes failure reports. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/RyanNSJ/notworking.

Development Tools & Utilities

  • fakegreen (⭐4) - Deterministic diff checker with an AfterAgent hook (npx fakegreen install gemini) that denies the turn when the agent skipped or deleted tests, weakened assertions, added suppressions, special-cased the test environment or forced CI green with || true, and feeds the findings back so Gemini fixes them. No LLM or API key. MIT.
  • yoink (⭐5) - Saves and switches Gemini CLI Google logins (oauth_creds.json and google_accounts.json) alongside Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code and GitHub Copilot logins, from a CLI or a macOS menu bar app.
  • aisw (⭐135) - Saves Gemini CLI logins and API keys as named profiles and switches the live ~/.gemini state in one command, alongside Claude Code, Codex CLI and Antigravity CLI. Docs: aiswitcher.dev.
  • LynxPrompt (⭐54) - Self-hosted web app that turns one set of AI coding rules into the file each tool reads: Gemini CLI's GEMINI.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor rules and Copilot instructions, 30 rule-file formats in all. Blueprints carry variables so a team shares one set across projects, and the lynxp CLI writes the files into each repository. AGPL-3.0.
  • spillage (⭐3) - Finds API keys in the chats, logs and checkpoints Gemini CLI keeps under ~/.gemini/tmp and in the MCP servers of ~/.gemini/settings.json, redacts them in place, and installs BeforeAgent / BeforeTool / SessionEnd hooks (spillage guard install) that block a prompt with a key in it and reads of .env. Python, no dependencies, no network; also covers Claude Code, Codex CLI and Cursor.

API Bridges & Proxies

  • cliproxy-rs (⭐41) - Rust rewrite of CLIProxyAPI with a built-in dashboard. Serves the Gemini API on a local endpoint (GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL), so Gemini CLI can run on Gemini API keys or on signed-in Claude and ChatGPT accounts.

MCP Servers

  • Connections (⭐1) - Work a free Connections contact book, follow-ups, ticketed event pages, notes and email from Gemini CLI; no card needed for the account. Remote Streamable HTTP MCP server with OAuth sign-in at https://studio.connections.icu/v1/mcp. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/Lunarwerx/connections-gemini-extension.
  • Selvedge (⭐25) - Local SQLite decision memory for Gemini CLI via stdio MCP, storing explicit decisions, reasons, and rejected approaches for retrieval across sessions. Setup: selvedge setup --agent gemini.
  • Unsora (⭐3) - AI content generation and social media scheduling from Gemini CLI: generate images, video, music and voiceovers, clip long videos into short clips, and schedule or publish posts to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Threads and Pinterest. Official open-source MCP server (AGPL-3.0, in apps/mcp), hosted as remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key. Paid plans from $19/month with a 3-day free trial. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http unsora https://mcp.tryunsora.com/mcp.
  • MAQAMI Travel (⭐2) - Hotel and flight search and booking from Gemini CLI: search hotels (3M+) and flights, read hotel details and reviews, then send the customer a secure checkout link on book.maqami.co for the offer they choose. Remote Streamable HTTP (https://mcp.maqami.co/), no sign-in or API key. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/negm17111995/mcp-server.
  • looot (⭐3) - Remote MCP server (OAuth sign-in) that searches, prices and runs 2,500+ data API endpoints from 90+ providers (emails, phones, company and people search, Google results, web pages) on one prepaid balance. Ships a Gemini CLI extension manifest.
  • BulkPublish (⭐3) - Draft, schedule, cross-post and analyze social media posts on 15 platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Bluesky and more) from Gemini CLI. Hosted Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, or local stdio via npx -y @bulkpublish/mcp-server with an API key; free plan available. MIT. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http bulkpublish https://mcp.bulkpublish.com/mcp.
  • QRX (⭐2) - Turn a text prompt and a link into an artistic, branded QR code from Gemini CLI. Each code is checked to scan before it is returned and uses a hosted qrx.to short link. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in or an API key, or local stdio via npx -y @qrxcodes/mcp. MIT. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http qrx https://qrx.codes/mcp.
  • Tapetide MCP (⭐142) - Indian stock market data for Gemini CLI: quotes, quarterly financials, shareholding, a 326-ratio screener, FII/DII flows, option chains and company filings for about 8,200 NSE and BSE stocks. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth or a free personal token, or local stdio via npx -y tapetide-mcp; free plan available. MIT. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/Tapetide-hq/nse-bse-indian-stock-market-data-mcp.
  • Hoot Lens (⭐2) - Session replays and click heatmaps from real website visits. Find clicks that broke, jump to the JavaScript error and source line, and check whether a fix helped. Remote with OAuth (httpUrl: https://mcp.hootlens.com/mcp) or local with npx -y @hootlens/mcp. Demo with sample data, no sign-in: https://mcp.hootlens.com/demo.
